claims.text: Proximal to sigmoid, or left-sided ⍉responding to topicals: a biologic (incl guselkumab, risankizumab, mirikizumab) ± an immunomodulator.
claims.quote: Patients with inflammation proximal to the sigmoid colon or left-sided disease unresponsive to topical agents should receive a biologic agent (infliximab, adalimumab, golimumab, guselkumab, risankizumab, mirikizumab, ustekinumab, vedolizumab) with or without an immunomodulator medication (azathioprine, methotrexate, 6-mercaptopurine)
